_comment: 'At the start of your turn, destroy Blessing of Spirits then create 3 Spectral Shield tokens.' Shape copied from dyn/blessing_of_focus_red (same set, same 'At the start of your turn, destroy...' wording, implemented). No IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER condition: trigger_types.py maps START_OF_TURN to an event that reaches only the turn player's cards, so 'your turn' is scoped by dispatch itself. Effects ordered destroy-then-create per the printed 'then'. CREATE_TOKEN handler reads 'token' (slug) and 'amount'; json/tokens/spectral_shield.json exists (its Ward comes from TOKEN_KEYWORDS). Ward 1 on this card is a printed keyword -> card DB keywords field, deliberately NOT authored here. Release note ('triggers and resolves during the start of turn phase, no priority') matches the engine's start-phase START_OF_TURN dispatch.
